QuestInfo.name: A Bite for Baine
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1092000##k gave you a nice, sturdy-looking pair of gloves. But Tangyoon looks like he has something else to ask of you...
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1092002##k's been skipping his meals, and #b#p1092000##k will have none of that! Deliver a Lunch Box to poor, hungry #b#p1092002##k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered #b#p1092000##k's lunch box to #b#p1092002##k. Pirate, waiter, what's the difference?

0.0: Anyway, the pork dish was a hit. But #b#p1092002##k skipped the meal. Guy needs to stop working so hard...\r\n
0.1: I got important things to do. Why don't you bring #b#p1092002##k his lunch for me?\r\n

yes.0: Bring this to #b#p1092002##k straight away. If I find out he had to go hungry, it's straight to the gallows with you!

no.0: Why you gotta be so disagreeable? We Pirates have to look out for each other!

1.0: What's that? Smells like #b#p1092000##k's cookin'! Who are you, and what're you doing with that lunch?

yes.0: Thanks, matey. I thought I was gonna starve. #b#p1092000##k makes the best grub.

npc.0: Take that lunch to #b#p1092002##k, fast! He's gotta be starving!

item.0: #b#p1092000##k sent ya, did she? So what's it about? I was hopin' for a #rPacked Lunch#k or somethin'... Man, I'm hungry...
